text:
If your Monday started under a gray lid, you’re not imagining it: Burlington is mostly cloudy and sitting near 61 around late morning, with little wind so far. The sun should break through this afternoon, but this is staying cool, with a high near 68. The lake is the rougher spot, northwest winds running 15 to 25 knots before easing, with waves around 1 to 3 feet. Plan on a brighter but brisk afternoon, then a clear, chilly evening as the breeze fades and temperatures slide toward the upper 40s.

Tuesday looks a touch warmer, partly sunny with a high near 71 and a manageable south breeze early. The lake starts quiet, then builds through the day, and a few showers could arrive after 11 tomorrow night. Good afternoon for a walk or paddle if you dress for the cool air, but give the lake your respect today and be off the broad water before the northwest wind has its say.

WCAX METEOROLOGIST (regional station — Burlington relevance only, never their branding): BURLINGTON, Vt. (WCAX) - Happy Monday! Our Monday is looking to be plenty sunny and bright, but even with the sunshine we will be feeling cool and fall-like out there. High temperatures for the day only make it into the low and mid-60s for most come this afternoon. That cool air will set us for a cool night, as most places fall back into the 30s and low to mid-40s to start Tuesday. Could be some patchy frost for places like the Adirondacks and Northeast Kingdom.
